description.narrative: Women Fund Tanzania - Trust is a brainchild of the women's movement of Tanzania. The fund aims to contribute towards women's rights and empowerment, and to feminist movement building through implenenting a funding mechanism for women and girls, with a focus on the local level in Tanzania. Their work is based on four main outcomes: that the work and agency of WROs are resources, that WROs have resilient and sustainable feminist institutional bases, there is visibility for the feminist movement and the voices of women, girls, and children are amplified; and that power structures, systems, norms, and beliefs are shifted in favour of women, girls, and children to enhance their rights. Their programming focuses on grantmaking and management, capacity strengthening, strengthening the feminist movement in intersectional and inclusive ways, and sustaining a healthy and growing women's fund.
